applicationsPanel.title: Voidcove Applications
requirements: Must be active in the server
Must be respectful to all members & staff
Must be mature and able to handle drama/problems
Must know and follow all server rules
Must put effort into your application (no 1 word answers)
Must have money to buy/sell spawners if needed
Must know basic server stuff (selling/buying skeleton spawners, support, etc.)
Must not have recent punishments or warnings
Must not scam, grief, or abuse your power over others
Must keep customer bases confidential and delete homes when requested
note: Asking for staff will lower chances
Asking about your app will get you denied
If you get denied you may reapply after 1 week

applications.label: Staff Application
questions: What is your Discord username, Discord ID, and Minecraft IGN?
What is your current age?
Why did you apply for staff here rather than other servers?
Share your past staff experiences.
Have you read the rules?
What is your playtime and balance on DonutSMP?
If someone was spamming and being toxic, how would you handle it?
If someone was being racist, how would you handle it?
If someone tried to bribe you to get a role or something, what would you do?
If you found out someone scammed another player, what would you do?
What are the top 3 things to do when a ticket is opened?
Do you understand that applications without very good detail will be denied?
Do you understand that if you do not meet all requirements, you will be denied?
